source_archive.verification_authority: E390-00 receipt; preserve original archive and per-file source manifest; archive is not committed into the GitHub Actions checkout

authority.hash_policy: Git blob SHA-1 values identify current source-file blobs only. They are not SHA-256 replacements for the source archive/per-file SHA-256 manifest.

matrix_cardinality.composition: component construction precedes 13 x 5 x 6 = 390 smooth matching matrix

coordinate_and_unit_contract.energy_per_baryon: MeV, with source rest-mass convention preserved
coordinate_and_unit_contract.slice: select T=0 by axis value and record exact iT; select the source-authoritative beta-equilibrium table slice and record the exact iYq/index; never infer a physical proton fraction from a stored Yq coordinate such as 0
coordinate_and_unit_contract.source_header: read mn, mp and Il from the eos.thermo header for each source; never replace them by universal hard-coded constants

columns.Nadd: provider-defined optional typed extension; preserve exact arity and values

compose_thermo_contract.first_law: For the selected T=0 one-parameter beta-equilibrium barotrope: F=epsilon/nB and P=nB*dF/dln(nB). Q6 and Q7 must agree within the declared source tolerance at T=0. Q1 is retained as the source pressure-per-baryon channel and is independently checked against the derivative of F.
checks: source Q3 versus Euler chemical potential
positive compressibility on smooth stable branches
phase-local derivative stencils; no derivative across an interface
compose_thermo_contract.no_repair_policy: Do not silently overwrite source Q1/Q3/Q6/Q7, shift the energy zero, clip cs2, smooth a physical transition, or fit an empirical gauge. Report a failed/diagnostic residual and preserve source values.

composition_contract.source_format: eos.compo rows keyed by (iT,inb,iYq); preserve Iphase, Npairs, particle-index/fraction pairs, Nquad and nuclear-group quadruples
composition_contract.presence: per-row/per-species/per-group presence masks from E390-02A are authoritative; absent is not zero, and an explicitly written zero is present
composition_contract.Iphase: categorical and model/provider-specific; the CompOSE manual states that the numeric-to-physical correspondence is defined on each model's EOS page
composition_contract.nuclear_group: preserve source tuple and raw YI; convert Yh=Abar*YI only when model semantics and applicability have been admitted; never map a final tuple by assumption
composition_contract.Nadd_q_extra: preserve exact source typing and row association or mark explicitly unsupported; never interpolate categorical/unknown fields as scalar values
composition_contract.SPG_GPPVA: dual-track contract: parse/retain original standard CompOSE records and masks; bypass unverified final-field remapping in production and reconstruct inner-crust composition from the cited CLD/Thomas-Fermi/model papers with separate provenance

artifact_lineage.raw_source: immutable provider ZIP and exact files; no mutation
artifact_lineage.normalized_source: lossless parse/normalization only: units/axes/indices/header, row sorting prohibited unless identity-preserving and explicitly logged
artifact_lineage.reconstructed_source: separate derived branch for literature-based composition/fields; original rows and hashes remain unchanged
artifact_lineage.core_only: only homogeneous core branch admitted by the model-specific source boundary; no imported crust rows
artifact_lineage.crust_only: all source-supported crust regimes through the crust EOS terminal support; no homogeneous high-density core tail
artifact_lineage.matched_composite: created only by a separately identified matching-method node and carries both component parents plus method ID/version

interface_schema.missing_policy: null plus explicit status; never numeric zero unless source contains an explicit zero

hard_stops: No core-only product for a model with an unresolved homogeneous-core boundary.
No crust-only product that omits a source-supported outer-crust, neutron-drip, inner-crust or source-labelled cluster/pasta interval.
No universal nB=0.045 fm^-3 fallback as a physical core boundary.
No fabricated composition or replacement of absent species by zero.
No use of archived source nB_max as a universal crust-core matching density.
No source mutation, in-place overwrite, or hash identity loss.
required_tests: exact eos.nb point count and bounds match the admitted source manifest; nB strictly increasing and finite
eos.t/eos.yq axes and (iT,inb,iYq) keys preserved exactly for the selected T=0 beta-equilibrium slice
mn/mp/Il parse from each eos.thermo header and all Q columns retain their CompOSE definitions
Q6/Q7 T=0 consistency and independent pressure/chemical-potential first-law residuals
C1-C11 applicability matrix reports CHECKED/PARTIAL/NOT_AVAILABLE/FAIL per source row without treating missing as zero
model-specific core boundary is cited, numerically represented or explicitly blocks construction
crust phase coverage includes all source-supported regimes and keeps neutron drip distinct from the BSk22 splice at 0.002 fm^-3
phase-local derivatives, mechanical stability and causality; failure retained without clipping or extrapolation
unknown Nadd/q_extra and phase fields are byte-preserved or explicitly unsupported
all transformations create new immutable versioned artifacts with input and output hashes
